title: https source
description: Receives HTTPS requests and replies with the flow's outcome (request-reply). Flows on the same host:port share one listener.

matchPrefix.title: Match prefix
matchPrefix.description: Also accept requests whose path starts with this path

matchOnUriPrefix.title: Match on URI prefix
matchOnUriPrefix.description: Same as matchPrefix (Camel's name); either one turns prefix matching on

exchangePattern.title: Exchange pattern
exchangePattern.description: InOut replies with the message the flow ends with; InOnly replies at once with the request and the flow goes on without the caller

authenticationPreemptive.title: Preemptive authentication
authenticationPreemptive.description: Accepted for compatibility; it only affects outbound calls, so it has no effect here

preserveHttpHeaders.title: Preserve HTTP headers
preserveHttpHeaders.description: Add the headers http.method, http.path, http.query and http.uri

serverIdentityFile.title: Server identity
serverIdentityFile.description: PKCS#12 keystore with the server's private key and certificate

serverIdentityPassword.title: Server identity password
serverIdentityPassword.description: Keystore password; env DIF_SERVER_IDENTITY_PASSWORD (or its _FILE companion)
